newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: DEPOSITS IN COMMERCIAL BANKS FALL IN FEB.
newsitem.headline: DEPOSITS IN COMMERCIAL BANKS FALL IN FEB.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Friday that deposits in the country's commercial banks fell in February to 4.9665 billion litas from 4.990 billion litas.
The central bank also said in its monthly bulletin that demand deposits comprised 59.6 percent of the total and times and savings deposits 40.4 percent.
It added that commercial bank loans increased to 4.0853 billion litas from 4.0386 billion litas during the month.
The bank said that interbank credits rose to 24.5 million litas from 15.0 million litas and that four million litas in credits in foreign exchange were granted compared with none the previous month.
The bank also said that the average interest rates on time and demand deposits in litas remained unchanged at 0.8 and 0.2 percent respectively.
